display_long_description:
(※)The current version available is the Demo (trial version). In this build, you can challenge up to Stage 1 using the following two weapons:
・Lethal Blade (Sword): A powerful melee weapon for devastating slashes
・Hand Cannon (Gun): A revolver-style arm cannon for long-range attacks
The full release is planned to feature additional weapons, new stages, special abilities, and a wider variety of enemies.

ARTIST SLAYER / RUSH is a stylish VR action game where players take on the role of the SLAYER, SLASH a horde of enemies(RUSH) with speed and precision. Wielding a variety of weapons such as swords and guns, you’ll unleash fast-paced, visceral combat that feels like channeling your inner rage.

・A technical combat style that blends slashing melee and ranged gunplay
・Intuitive controls and immersive action unique to VR
・Thrilling stages filled with relentless enemy hordes
・Grotesque, gory expressions that awaken your inner demon
・Intense rock and metal soundtrack combined with realistic sound effects
・Concept art exhibition inside the game
